column3: NASB puts this verse in parentheses.
“Father sons” is rendered “become the fathers of sons.”
“To the mouth of” is rendered “When … have been completed”; “give attention to” becomes “visit.”
“Turn back your captivity” is rendered “restore your fortunes.”
“Rotten figs” is rendered “split-open figs”; the meaning is uncertain.
“Rising early and sending” is rendered “again and again.”
“A curse will be taken from them” is rendered “because of them a curse shall be used.”
“To be overseers” is rendered “to be the overseer.”
“It will be long” is rendered “The exile will be long”; NASB supplies “The exile.”
